high_level_description: The image depicts a person sitting on the ground outdoors at night, enjoying a slice of cake. The individual is wearing a denim jacket with a fur-lined hood and a white shirt underneath. They have long, wavy blonde hair and are holding a fork with a piece of cake on it to their mouth. In front of them is an open cardboard box containing a round cake with pink frosting. The cake has green icing writing on it that reads "PUSHING 20 SABRECA ARPUIN." The setting appears to be a casual, possibly impromptu celebration, given the informal attire and the simple presentation of the cake
